blurb:
Visit the pride of Prince Edward County, with its rolling sand dunes and temperate clear waters. You'll be left grinning from ear to ear as the city line disappears. Lake Fever is camping at its simplest. Guests will enjoy free transportation from Toronto, 3 square meals, and a good old fashioned campfire. Best of all, NO CAMPING EXPERIENCE OR EQUIPMENT NECESSARY (not even a sleeping bag). First-timers will all learn the basics of camping.

Guests will have the opportunity to hike, swim, paddle (optional) and go wine tasting. Lake Fever offers budget travelers of all experience levels access to the great Canadian wilderness for a unique opportunity that would otherwise take a lot of planning and money to arrange. As a tourist, or a local without a vehicle, this could be your once-in-a-lifetime experience.
